name: Steve Shockley
occupation: Platte County commissioner and board chairman (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Platte County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; described as commission chairman by Cowboy State Daily in August 2025)
background: Steve Shockley is a Platte County commissioner and board chairman and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Cowboy State Daily reported in August 2025 that he was commission chairman when the board accepted Sheriff David Russell's resignation. The official 2026 general election summary lists him with 2,452 votes.
